system.specialAbility:
You become Trained in Crafting and Thievery, and you become Trained in a relevant Lore of your choice.

Example Lores include Locks Lore, Security Devices Lore, Safe Construction Lore.
system.description: You made locks dependable and opened them when their owners could not. Years of patient work taught you how small a fault can make a strong door useless.
